# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Meta releases 816B-parameter Muse Spark Open](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-muse-spark-open.html): Meta has released its largest open-weight model, pairing a 1M-token context window with coding, multimodal and long-running agent capabilities.
- [Nvidia Opens 2.8T-Token Pipeline for Indic AI Models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/nvidia-indic-pretraining-pipeline.html): Nvidia details a 2.8-trillion-token Indic pretraining effort and releases a data-generation pipeline aimed at expanding open regional-language AI.
- [OpenAI offers GPT-Rosalind to academic biology labs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-rosalind-academic-plan.html): OpenAI is giving eligible university labs up to 30 sponsored seats for GPT-Rosalind, its specialized model for biological discovery workflows.
- [Perplexity open-sources SPACE for safer AI agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/perplexity-space-agent-sandbox.html): Perplexity has open-sourced a persistent sandbox designed to contain computer-using agents while preserving state across long-running tasks.
- [Replit CEO Pitches the Rise of Self-Driving Companies](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/replit-self-driving-company.html): Replit’s CEO argues that AI agents will let companies operate through increasingly autonomous software teams, shifting the debate from coding tools to work design.
- [Amazon Adds Shopping to Bee’s New Personal AI Devices](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/amazon-bee-frontier-eclipse.html): Amazon’s Bee Frontier wearable and Bee Eclipse phone attachment extend ambient AI into reminders, Alexa+ and personalized shopping.
- [Google Brings Gemini 4 Argon to Global Consumer App](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-4-argon-global-app-launch.html): Google has opened its frontier Gemini 4 Argon model to Pro and Ultra subscribers worldwide, linking long-horizon reasoning with delegated tasks.
- [Skywork Releases Open Matrix-Game 4.0 for Real-Time Worlds](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/skywork-matrix-game-4.html): Skywork says Matrix-Game 4.0 is an open-source video model game that runs in real time on one consumer GPU.
- [StepFun Opens Step 5 Preview Weights for Long-Horizon Agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/step5-preview-open-weights.html): StepFun has released Step 5 Preview as open weights, pairing a 600B sparse MoE model with a new harness for sustained agent work.
- [Google and Singapore Build On-Device Scam Detection Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-singapore-on-device-scam-ai.html): Google DeepMind and Singapore’s GovTech have built an on-device Gemma-based system for localized scam conversations; its rollout within messaging platforms and applications will be phased and consent-based.
- [Meshy’s 3D Agent Remains in Beta, with Free Trial Still Pending](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meshy-3d-agent-leaves-beta.html): Meshy’s conversational 3D Agent remains in public beta for Pro members and above, while a free trial is still forthcoming.
- [Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy as Disney Deal Emerges](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/character-ai-bankruptcy-disney-deal.html): Character.AI has filed for bankruptcy while pursuing a Disney transaction, exposing the financial strain facing consumer AI platforms built on costly engagement.
- [Meta launches Muse Wonder for long-running AI agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-muse-wonder-frontier-agents.html): Meta’s first frontier-class models target persistent memory, computer use and complex coding, putting its consumer-agent strategy on a new footing.
- [Microsoft targets multi-gigawatt scale for Maia 300](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/microsoft-maia-300-multi-gigawatt.html): Microsoft says its Maia 300 inference system will reach multi-gigawatt deployments in 2027, challenging Nvidia’s role in its largest AI workloads.
- [Alibaba introduces elastic RL for long-horizon agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/qwengyre-elastic-agent-training.html): Alibaba’s QwenGyre framework reallocates training resources across difficult rollouts, reporting gains on long-horizon software-engineering tasks.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Meta发布8160亿参数开放权重模型Muse Spark Open](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-muse-spark-open.html): Meta发布迄今最强的美国开放权重模型，主打百万上下文、编码、多模态理解和长时间自主执行。
- [英伟达开源印地语系AI预训练数据管线](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/nvidia-indic-pretraining-pipeline.html): 英伟达公布覆盖2.8万亿词元的印地语系预训练项目，并开放数据生成管线，推动区域语言模型扩展。
- [OpenAI向高校实验室开放GPT-Rosalind生物研究计划](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-rosalind-academic-plan.html): OpenAI推出学术计划，为符合条件的高校实验室提供最多30个免费席位，接入面向生命科学研究的GPT-Rosalind。
- [Perplexity开源SPACE，为长程智能体提供安全沙箱](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/perplexity-space-agent-sandbox.html): Perplexity开源SPACE沙箱，试图在保留任务状态的同时隔离可执行命令、安装软件和调用外部服务的智能体。
- [Replit CEO提出“自动驾驶公司”构想](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/replit-self-driving-company.html): Replit CEO认为，AI代理将接管更多软件团队和业务流程，企业竞争焦点也将从编程工具转向工作方式重构。
- [亚马逊推出两款Bee设备，个人AI接入购物场景](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/amazon-bee-frontier-eclipse.html): 亚马逊发布Bee Frontier可穿戴设备和Bee Eclipse手机配件，将环境式AI连接到提醒、Alexa+和个性化购物。
- [谷歌全球开放Gemini 4 Argon，聊天应用转向任务代理](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-4-argon-global-app-launch.html): Gemini 4 Argon现已面向全球Pro和Ultra订阅者开放，谷歌正把前沿推理模型直接嵌入可委托执行任务的消费级应用。
- [Skywork发布Matrix-Game 4.0，单张消费级显卡实时运行](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/skywork-matrix-game-4.html): Skywork推出开源Matrix-Game 4.0，主打在单张消费级显卡上实时运行的互动视频模型。
- [阶跃星辰开源Step 5 Preview，面向长程智能体任务](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/step5-preview-open-weights.html): 阶跃星辰公开Step 5 Preview权重，推出6000亿参数稀疏MoE模型及配套智能体工作流工具。
- [谷歌与新加坡打造端侧诈骗识别模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-singapore-on-device-scam-ai.html): 谷歌DeepMind与新加坡GovTech已完成面向本地诈骗对话的端侧Gemma模型，后续将在应用中分阶段、经用户同意后部署。
- [Meshy的3D智能体仍处于公测阶段，免费试用尚未开放](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meshy-3d-agent-leaves-beta.html): Meshy的对话式3D Agent目前仅面向Pro及以上会员公测，免费试用仍在筹备中。
- [Character.AI申请破产保护，迪士尼交易浮出水面](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/character-ai-bankruptcy-disney-deal.html): Character.AI在寻求与迪士尼交易之际申请破产保护，暴露出消费级AI平台高成本运营与变现之间的矛盾。
- [Meta发布Muse Wonder，押注长时运行智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-muse-wonder-frontier-agents.html): Meta首次推出面向前沿竞争的Muse Wonder系列，主打持久记忆、电脑操作和复杂编程，个人智能体战略由此进入新阶段。
- [微软计划2027年将Maia 300扩至多吉瓦规模](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/microsoft-maia-300-multi-gigawatt.html): 微软公布Maia 300推理系统，计划从2027年起部署多吉瓦规模，云厂商自研芯片对英伟达的替代压力进一步上升。
- [阿里Qwen推出面向长程智能体的弹性强化学习](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/qwengyre-elastic-agent-training.html): 阿里Qwen发布QwenGyre框架，按任务难度动态分配训练资源，并在长程软件工程任务上报告明显提升。

## Pages

- [All briefings (English)](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/): the full feed
- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-10-16.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources
- Categories: [models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/models.html), [research](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/research.html), [policy](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/policy.html), [industry](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/industry.html), [funding](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/funding.html), [open-source](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/open-source.html), [safety](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/safety.html), [aigc](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/aigc.html), [agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/agents.html)

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
